# Achhaya Pathak

> IIT Guwahati MS alumnus and Software / Backend Engineer with 3+ years of experience architecting distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), high-performance web applications (Rust/WASM, Next.js), and autonomous AI agent pipelines.

Achhaya Pathak is a software engineer based in Gurugram, India. Co-founder of JoinUp (an event marketplace and discovery platform serving 100K+ monthly requests at 99.99% uptime). Specializes in building resilient backend systems, low-latency microservices, and AI-driven automation workflows.

## Key Projects
- [JoinUp](https://joinup.dev): Event discovery and management marketplace built with Next.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS/GCP.
- [Distributed Document Search](https://github.com/achhayapathak/distributed-document-search): Production-grade multi-tenant distributed search service with Elasticsearch, Kafka, and Redis delivering sub-200ms searches over millions of documents.
- [Job Assist AI](https://github.com/achhayapathak/job-assist-ai-backend): Agentic AI platform for automating job discovery, recruiter insights extraction, and tailoring ATS-friendly resumes.
- [Event Aggregation Engine](https://github.com/joinupdev): Agentic AI engine for crawling, deduplicating, and standardizing professional event feeds.

## Professional Experience
- [JoinUp](https://achhaya.com/work): Co-Founder (March 2025 – Present). Scaled a 0→1 marketplace to 100K+ monthly requests with sub-500ms geospatial query latency and 3,000+ organic users/month.
- [Marlin](https://achhaya.com/work): Software Engineer (April 2025 – May 2026). Engineered LLM-driven trading AI agents, RabbitMQ microservices handling 50+ signals/min, and Kubernetes clusters in Confidential VMs.
- [Gist Impact](https://achhaya.com/work): Software Development Engineer (Feb 2024 – Apr 2025). Managed infrastructure for sustainability platforms processing ~5 TB/month, cut CI/CD build times by 6x, and automated Snowflake ETLs.
- [Aristocrat Gaming](https://achhaya.com/work): Game Developer (Aug 2023 – Jan 2024). Optimized mathematical simulation models in C++ and JavaScript, reducing runtime from 10h to 2.5h.
